description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations, comparing their performance. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (navy blue, solid). The Vanilla line starts at approximately 3.39 and decreases to around 2.49 at 140000 iterations. The StrmLLM (n=64) line begins at about 3.4 and drops to roughly 2.63 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 2.52 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line begins at about 3.25 and drops to roughly 2.51 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to around 2.51 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at about 3.23 and drops to roughly 2.5 at 140000 iterations. All lines exhibit a decreasing trend, with a steeper decline in the initial iterations and a more gradual decrease as the number of iterations increases.
